questions.question: India's first official census operation was undertaken in which year?
questions.solution: The first complete census was taken in the year 1881.

questions.question: "Relief of the disabled and unemployable" is listed in the __________ list given in the Seventh Schedule in the Constitution of India.
questions.solution:
Option **2** is correct, i.e. __**State**__.

 
• The state list or **List-II** is a **list of 61 items** in Schedule Seven to the constitution of India.
 
• Initially, there were 66 items in the list.
 
• "**Relief of the disabled and unemployable**" is listed in the state list.

**Extra facts:**

Seventh Schedule of the Indian constitution gives allocation of powers and functions between Union & States. It contains 3 lists:-

1. Union List (For central Govt) 100 Subjects (originally 97).

2. **States List** (Powers of State Govt) **61 subjects** (originally 66). 

3.Concurrent List (Both Union & States) 52 subjects (originally 47).

questions.question: ________ amends the Constitution.

options.text: Securities and Exchange Board of India

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Parliament**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Amending the Constitution of India is the process of making changes to the nation's fundamental law or supreme law.
 
• The procedure of amendment in the constitution is laid down in **Part XX (Article 368)** of the Constitution of India.
 
• This procedure ensures the sanctity of the Constitution of India and keeps a check on the arbitrary power of the **Parliament** of India.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• The Parliament can amend the constitution in three ways:
 
 
• **By simple majority.**
 
• **By special majority.**
 
• **By special majority but with the consent of half of all the state legislature**.
 
 
 
• By simple majority: A simple majority, that is, a majority of the members of the House present and voting. 
 
• By special majority: A special majority of the Parliament, i.e., a two-third majority of the members of each House present and voting, and a majority (that is, more than 50 percent), of the total membership of each House. 
 
• By special majority but with the concern of half of all the state legislature.

questions.question: According to the categories of land mentioned in the Chola inscriptions _________ was known as the land gifted to temples?

questions.question: The method of soil conservation in which different crops are grown in alternate rows and are sown at different times to protect the soil from rain wash is called?
questions.solution: Intercropping is the cultivation of two or more crops simultaneously on the same field. It also means growing of two or more crops on the same field with the planting of the second crop after the first one has completed its development.

questions.question: In each testes in a male reproductive system, there are ________ compartments called testicular lobules.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**250.**__

**Explanation: **The glandular structure of the testis consists of numerous lobules. Their number, in a single testis, is estimated by Berres at **250**.

**Functions:**

 
• The testicles are the **male gonads — the primary male reproductive organs.** They have two, very important functions that are very important to the male reproductive system: they produce gametes or sperm, and they secrete hormones, primarily testosterone. 
 
• Each testicle consists of a series of small tubes, or tubules, that contain testosterone and sperm-producing cells.
 
• Seminiferous tubules house germ cells — the 23 chromosome cells that men replicate to produce sperm and they are the site of sperm production, or spermatogenesis, according to VMC.
 
• These tubules are tightly coiled within the testis, and each testis may contain up to 900 tubules. The tubules are almost 20 inches (50 cm) long, and a typical testis contains up to half a mile (800 meters) of seminiferous tubules.

questions.question: The predominant stage of the life cycle of a moss is the gametophyte which consists of two stages. The second stage is the _________ stage.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Leafy**

**__Explanation:__**

In the life cycle of mosses, the gametophyte stage includes two main stages:

 
• Protonema: The first stage, which is a thread-like structure that develops from the spore.
 
• Leafy: The second stage, which develops from the protonema and consists of a small leafy plant. The leafy stage develops from a lateral bud in the secondary protonema. It is a small leafy structure consisting of rhizoids, leaves and stem. It bears sex organs antheridia and archegonia.

questions.question: In Animal Kingdom classification, which of the following is not a Phylum?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Coelomates.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The **animals **which **possess true coelom** are called **eucoelomates or coelomates**. The **true coelom** is a **body cavity **which **arises as a cavity in embryonic mesoderm.**
 
• In more simpler words, any animal possessing a fluid-filled cavity within which the digestive system is suspended is called coelomates.

questions.question: Friction is caused by the _________ on the two surfaces in contact.
questions.solution: Friction is the force resisting the relative motion of solid surfaces, fluid layers, and material elements sliding against each other.

questions.question: The motion of a freely falling body is an example of _________ motion.
questions.solution: Uniform or constant acceleration is a type of motion in which the velocity of an object changes by an equal amount in every equal time period. A frequently cited example of uniform acceleration is that of an object in free fall in a uniform gravitational field.

questions.question: ________ (HHDD) is a technology where the conventional disk drive is combined with non-volatile flash memory, of typically 128 MB or more to cache data during normal use.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Hybrid Hard Disk Drive**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In computing, a hybrid drive is a logical or physical storage device that combines a fast storage medium such as NAND flash solid-state drive (SSD) with a hard disk drive (HDD).
 
• The intent of adding some of the speed of flash storage to the cost-effective storage capacity of traditional HDDs. 
 
• It is a technology where the conventional disk drive is combined with non-volatile flash memory, of typically 128 MB or more to cache data during normal use.

questions.question: Chemical formula for sulfurous acid is ________.
questions.solution:
• Sulphurous acid is the chemical compound with the formula H₂SO₃.
 
• There is no evidence that sulfurous acid exists in solution, but the molecule has been detected in the gas phase.

**Note: **Chemical formula for **Sulphuric acid **is ***H₂SO₄.***

questions.question: The temperature at which a solid melts to become a liquid at the atmospheric pressure is called its ________.
questions.solution: The melting point of a solid is the temperature at which it changes state from solid to liquid at atmospheric pressure. At the melting point the solid and liquid phase exist in equilibrium.

questions.question: ________ scheme by the Central Government aims at providing affordable aviation by making domestic flight charges economically accessible for middle - class citizens of India.
questions.solution: UDAN (Ude Desh ka Aam Naagrik) is a regional airport development and *"Regional Connectivity Scheme (RCS)"* of the Government of India, with the objective of "Let the common citizen of the country fly". It is aimed at making air travel affordable and widespread, enabling inclusive job growth and infrastructure development of all regions and states of India.

questions.question: Who invented the hot air balloon?
questions.solution: The brothers Joseph - Michel and Jacques - Étienne Montgolfier developed a hot air balloon in France and demonstrated it publicly on September 19, 1783, making an unmanned flight lasting 10 minutes.

questions.question: Which nation won the highest number of medals at 2016 Rio Olympics?
questions.solution: The 2016 Summer Olympics was celebrated in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil, from 5 to 21 August 2016. The United States topped the medal table for the fifth time in the past six Summer Olympics, winning the most golds (46) and most medals overall (121).

questions.question: Group of Monuments at Hampi is located in?
questions.solution: Hampi was the last capital of the last great Hindu Kingdom of Vijayanagar. Its fabulously rich princes built Dravidian temples and palaces which won the admiration of travellers between the 14th and 16th centuries.

questions.question: Which of the following is India's highest civilian award?
questions.solution: The Bharat Ratna is the highest civilian award of the Republic of India. Instituted in 1954, the award is conferred "in recognition of exceptional service/performance of the highest order", without distinction of race, occupation, position, or sex.

questions.question:
Which of the statements given below are correct?

1. The author of the novel 'An Affair Downstairs' is Sherri Browning.

2. The author of the novel 'White Teeth' is Zadie Smith.

3. The author of the novel 'Atonement' is Ian McEwan.
questions.solution: The author of the novel 'An Affair Downstairs' is Sherri Browning. The author of the novel 'White Teeth' is Zadie Smith. The author of the novel 'Atonement' is Ian McEwan.

questions.question: Recently, scientists have found second Great Spot 24000 km across and 12000 km wide on which planet?
questions.solution: Astronomers describe the Great Cold Spot as a localized dark spot, up to 14,913miles (24,000 km) in longitude and 7,456 miles (12,000 km) in latitude, in Jupiter's thin high - altitude thermosphere.

questions.question: The Sundarbans Reserve Forest (SRF) which is adjacent to India's Sundarbans National Park is located in which neighbouring country?
questions.solution: The Sundarbans Reserve Forest located in the south - west of Bangladesh is the largest contiguous mangrove forest in the world. It is situate in between the river Baleswar in the east and the harin banga in the west, adjoining to the Bay of Bengal.
